messages.subject: Corporate Affairs & ESG Executive | Government Relations, Sustainability & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Katrina,

Your global work across corporate affairs, ESG and sustainability, communications, investor relations and public/government affairs makes Andrews Partnership one of the strongest functional fits for my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional trust, policy engagement, sustainability and enterprise strategy intersect. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
